newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Pakhoed to buy 50 pct of two French firms.
newsitem.headline: Pakhoed to buy 50 pct of two French firms.

text.p: Dutch tank storage and shipping group Pakhoed NV said on Wednesday it had reached agreement in principle to buy 50 percent of two French chemical distribution companies, Gazechim Produits et Specialites Chimiques and Gazechim Rhones Alpes.
The firms, which together generate annual turnover of some 400 million French francs ($75.6 million), will be acquired by Pakhoed's fully-owned French subsidiary Lambert Riviere S.A, Pakhoed said.

"Both in terms of product and geographically, they (the two companies) are complementary to the activities of Lambert Riviere, which generates annual sales of some 1300 million French francs in France," Pakhoed said.
It said the acquisition fitted with its strategy to become a major player in logistics and distribution for the oil and chemical industry worldwide.
